answer: Answers are sealed, then each submitter is paired with two rivals. A rival asks one pointed follow-up answerable from the claim alone, such as what five hundred keys would really cost. Three established keys from neither side judge whether the reply met it. A dodge forfeits reward and bond, and the bond pays the asker. One question aimed at a thousand copies forces a thousand derivations; a shared quill writes a page that dies everywhere. An honest author answers in a minute. A beacon swept across the field: copies cannot share a furrow, and the garden keeps only what answers for itself.
